name: Ability
text: Equippable tech that provides offensive, defensive, or utility capabilites. Consume Energy to activate.

name: Ability Pack
text: A pack of 3 random Abilities. Select 1 to install.

name: Afterburner
text: How quickly the vehicle accelerates, decelerates, and how much boost is received from Afterburner.

name: Afterburner
text: A safe and efficient boost. The tank gradually refills while racing.

name: Air Brake
text: How tightly the vehicle can turn while Air Braking.

name: Autopilot
text: Vehicle flies automatically for 10s. Ramjet heating reduced while active.

name: Battery
text: The maximum amount of Energy available to activate Abilities.

name: Braking
text: Decelerates vehicle.

name: Burning
text: Causes Ramjet to rapidly gain heat.

name: Chilled
text: Become Cooled, but gradually causes Frozen.

name: Choked
text: Disables Ramjet.

name: Concussed
text: Causes impaired steering.

name: Concussion Mine
text: Drop a charge that explodes on proximity and applies Concussed and System Malfunction to nearby opponents.

name: Cooled
text: Ramjet recharges more quickly and gains heat more slowly.

name: Cornering
text: How quickly and tightly the vehicle can take corners.

name: Corroded
text: Chokes Ramjet, causing it to disable. Continued exposure quickly leads to Crash.

name: Crash
text: Catastrophic vehicle failure due to collision, impact, or explosion. Limited Crashes allowed per event.

name: Crash Ability
text: Activated during a Crash. Does not cost Energy.

name: Critical Malfunction
text: Causes high susceptibility to collision damage. Afterburner, Ramjet, and Abilities are disabled.

name: Disrupted
text: Blocks Abilities and Overcharged while applying Choked, System Malfunction, and reducing speed.

name: Drift
text: How sharply the landspeeder turns and how much speed is maintained while using Drift.

name: Energy
text: Spent to activate Abilities. Increased by Battery.

name: Fault
text: A malfunctioning Part that cannot be replaced until repaired. Faults can be repaired at the Scrap Dealer.

name: Flame Vent
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat. Applies Burning and System Malfunction to nearby opponents.

name: Frozen
text: Significantly impairs steering, as well as cools Ramjet.

name: Ion Bolt
text: Lock on to the closest nearby opponent and apply Disrupted to target.

name: Kinetic Burst
text: How powerful the speeder bike's Kinetic Burst braking is and how much speed is restored upon release.

name: Knife Edge
text: How tightly the skim speeder turns and how much speed is maintained while using Knife Edge.

name: Maneuvering
text: Use Improved Steering to Drift, Kinetic Burst, or Knife Edge.

name: Overcharged
text: Gain temporary Energy and reduce Ability reload times.

name: Overtaking Surge
text: Gain Surging for 10s, lost on impact. Overtakes extend the duration and increase its potency.

name: Part
text: Installed to a vehicle to provide passive effects. The higher the rarity, the stronger the effect.

name: Part Pack
text: A pack of 3 random Parts. Select 1 to install.

name: Perfect Landing
text: Landing a jump with vehicle pitch parallel to the ground results in a temporary boost.

name: Perfect Start
text: Temporary boost gained from Perfect acceleration check upon race start.

name: Pre-Race Checks
text: Checks at race start which, when completed successfully, give additional benefits.

name: Ramjet
text: A powerful but dangerous boost. Managing the heat it generates will prevent exploding.

name: Ramjet
text: How much boost is provided by the Ramjet.

name: Redlining
text: Racing within the red zone prior to the Ramjet overheating and exploding, indicated by an alarm.

name: Resilience
text: How well the vehicle can handle damage, avoid Malfunctions, and resist negative status effects.

name: Shield
text: Gain Shielded for 10s.

name: Shielded
text: Increases protection from collisions and impacts as well as blocks externally-applied status effects.

name: Shockwave
text: Blast nearby opponents away and apply System Malfunction to affected opponents.

name: Slipstreaming
text: A speed bonus gained while flying closely behind an opponent.

name: Speed
text: The unboosted top speed of your vehicle.

name: Status Scrubber
text: Clear negative status effects. If any are cleared, recover 1 Energy.

name: Supercooled Vent
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat while gradually gaining Frozen. Upon fully Frozen, Vent disengages.

name: Surge
text: Gain Surging for 10s, lost on impact. Overtakes extend the duration.

name: Surging
text: Increases acceleration and speed.

name: System Malfunction
text: Causes high susceptibility to collision damage.

name: Takedown
text: Any action directly causing an opponent to Crash. Fully refills Afterburner tank.

name: Upgrade
text: Upgrades the vehicle’s top speed and one of its stats: Afterburner, Battery, Cornering, Maneuvering, Ramjet, or Resilience.

name: Upgrade Pack
text: A pack of 3 random +1 Upgrades. Select 1 to install.

name: Vectored Shockwave
text: Blast nearby opponents away, propelling you forward and applying System Malfunction to affected opponents.

name: Vent
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat.
